newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish president calls election for September 21.
newsitem.headline: Polish president calls election for September 21.

text.p: Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski signed an official resolution on Wednesday confirming parliamentary elections will be held on September 21, the presidential press office said.
Political parties will have until September 1 to register candidates for the lower house of parliament and the Senate with the State Electoral Commission.

The main contenders will be the co-ruling ex-communist Democratic Left Alliance (SLD) and the rightist Solidarity Election Action (AWS), with opinion polls currently showing about 25 percent support for each.
